name: Cognition & Swarm Intelligence
tagline: In-memory graph retrieval, SIMD vector search, and multi-algorithm swarm optimization.

projects.name: Hypertensor GraphRAG
projects.description: In-memory typed property-graph store with hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval. Dense search uses SIMD TensorPrimitives, with optional Level Zero GPU offload. It gives agents multi-hop graph context through a 65+ tool FastMCP server and a desktop HUD.

projects.name: HyperSwarm Optimization Suite
projects.description: Swarm optimization framework covering core, hybrid, advanced and multi-objective algorithms. It has Director-managed subswarm ensembles, convergence and diversity monitoring, Pareto-sorting threshold tuning, and a desktop visualizer.

projects.name: SwarmDev
projects.description: Deterministic prompt-to-workflow pipeline. It does intent classification, planning, knowledge-graph construction, frame routing, policy-gated normalization and diagnostics. Optional kGNN reasoning and wavescan layers are opt-in.

projects.name: SwarmBench
projects.description: Benchmarking, characterization, elimination tournaments and real-time visualization HUD running 34 optimization algorithms against 110 test functions with HyperCache config reuse and self-validating LaTeX/JSON profiles.

name: Machine Learning & Acceleration
tagline: Spiking and graph-based ML, heterogeneous accelerator orchestration, and IPU-offloaded SQL.

projects.name: AutoMLApp (in development)
projects.description: Windows node-graph editor (.NET 10/WinForms) for composing, validating and running ML and accelerator pipelines. Visual node-graph workbench with 185+ node types, F7 validation, and pluggable HyperSwarm backend.

projects.name: HFLabs Machine Learning Suite
projects.description: Spiking neural networks, contextual and intergraph inference, and knowledge-graph embeddings (KGE). It also has hyperparameter optimization (Bayesian, Hyperband, BOHB, ASHA-BOHB, TuRBO) and a Level Zero LLM inference engine with graph-constrained beam decoding.

projects.name: Accelerator
projects.description: Unified hardware-accelerator layer. A gRPC service executes plan envelopes across IPU (Poplar), CUDA, OpenCL, Level Zero, FPGA and DMA/RDMA backends. It includes backend discovery and scoring, a compiled-graph cache, and a KV-cache tier.

projects.name: IPU SQL Query Acceleration (MVP)
projects.description: A PostgreSQL extension and a SQL Server CLR bridge offload aggregates (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX) and vector distance ops (cosine, dot, L2) to the IPU through a gRPC microservice. Arrow columnar transport and the planner cost model are still planned.

name: Hardware & Native Substrates
tagline: Intel Level Zero interop, precompiled kernels, Graphcore Poplar bindings, and header-to-binding generation.

projects.name: LevelZero.NET & Kernel Catalog
projects.description: Single-DLL managed API, native shim, and 407 pre-compiled kernel modules (37 distinct kernels across 11 Intel GPU targets). 37 kernel wrappers across Swarm, SNN, LLM Inference, and Knowledge Retrieval with typed Unified Shared Memory and auto device detection.

projects.name: Poplar.NET (in development)
projects.description: C ABI shim and managed .NET wrapper for Graphcore Poplar/PopART. It covers devices, graph construction, inference and training sessions, optimizers, and safe native handles. It requires the Graphcore Poplar SDK, which isn't included.

projects.name: Abigen (in development)
projects.description: libclang-driven generator that reads C/C++ headers, emits reviewed/verified C# bindings, and manages upstream release tracking. Features fail-closed validation, manifest reproducibility, and a Windows desktop dashboard.
